fact: The BDIC managing director says the Benue state government has launched a digital-skills programme to train 40,000 public servants across state and local governments in digital tools and e-governance platforms.
The BDIC managing director says over 4,800 Benue civil servants have been trained so far in ICT fundamentals, digital workflow systems and enterprise platforms, with weekly numbers rising.
Benue State announced it is committing to train 40,000 civil servants in digital tools and ICT skills, with the Nigerian Data Protection Commission providing part of the training.
